title: Progress (Indeterminate)
summary: A stack of native <progress> bars with no value, animating the modernist myth of artistic advance toward a finish they can never reach.
mechanism: Native HTML <progress> elements left without a value attribute, so the browser is spec-obliged to draw perpetual indeterminate striving; unstyled, vendor-drawn, and frozen by prefers-reduced-motion.
references: Alfred H. Barr Jr., Cubism and Abstract Art flowchart (MoMA, 1936)
